metadata.method: BM25F phrase scoring over full-text PDFs
metadata.normalization: Each concept's paper scores are divided by that concept's maximum paper score; prevalence is their mean.
metadata.similarity: Cosine similarity between corpus-wide paper relevance vectors.
metadata.family_profile: Per paper, the maximum normalized relevance among themes assigned to the family.
metadata.family_color_weights: Cosine similarities to the six family profiles, normalized to sum to one.
metadata.alias_matching: Case-folded exact phrases with punctuation normalized to spaces; longest overlapping alias wins.
